detail.title: Intex 7 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine (Red & White) -SA70BDHG
detail.overview: Experience next-level washing with the SA70BDHG 7 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine. Designed for deep cleaning and convenience, it features a high-performance motor, Scrubber Technology, and 3 Fins Pulsator for an ultra-powerful wash. The Dual Waterfall system ensures even detergent mixing, while the Lint Filter keeps your clothes fresh. With a Noise-Free Spin Dryer, End Cycle Buzzer, and Anti-Corrosive Body, this washing machine is the perfect blend of performance and durability.
features: 7 KG Large Capacity – Ideal for small to medium families
Anti-Corrosive Rust-Free Body – Built to last
2 Wash Programs – Gentle & Normal modes for all fabric types
3 Fins Pulsator – Strong water flow for powerful stain removal
Scrubber Technology – Extra cleaning for heavily soiled clothes
Dual Waterfall – Even detergent distribution for a superior wash
Magic Lint Filter – Traps dirt, keeping clothes fresh
Water Level Indicator – Controls water usage efficiently
End Cycle Buzzer – Alerts you when the wash is done
Powerful Motor with TOP Technology – High-efficiency washing
Noise-Free Spinning – Smooth & silent drying experience
Hydraulic Lid – Soft-closing design for easy handling
